Filter by Date Range

Source: R/filter_date.R
filter_date.Rd

Filter a data.frame by specific date range.

Usage

filter_date(x, colname = NULL, ref = Sys.Date(), unit = "month")

Arguments

x

a data.frame with a Date or POSIXct column

colname

an optional character string to provide the name of the column to use in filter

ref

an optional Date value to be used as a reference for the date range

unit

a string to compute the date range (default = "month") (see round_date)

Value

a filtered data.frame

Details

The purpose of this function is to make data navigation between date range easier. By default, it will filter the input data.frame to keep dates belonging to the current month.

Examples

# -- this month (the default)
filter_date(data.frame(date = Sys.Date() - runif(n = 10, min = -50, max = 50)))
#>         date
#> 1 2026-08-07
#> 2 2026-08-21
#> 3 2026-08-18

# -- previous month
filter_date(data.frame(date = Sys.Date() - runif(n = 10, min = -50, max = 50)),
ref = Sys.Date() - as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%d")))
#>         date
#> 1 2026-07-11
#> 2 2026-07-01
